claim_boundary: Target-blind implementation and source-only invariant audit. Prior NVOS development metrics are known, but no target RGB, target mask, or target metric may be opened by this experiment.
first_principles_hypothesis: The dense source-view positive/negative/unknown posterior is the data term. Every primitive with nonzero exact-adjoint source confidence is a Dirichlet boundary. The graph may complete only confidence-zero primitives and may not rewrite source-observed evidence.

fixed_method.source_posterior: Replay the already sealed hierarchical SAM3 posterior: full entropy-calibrated Bernoulli only when its frozen all-trial LOO gate accepts; otherwise strict local-majority positive evidence with raw positive/negative overrides and zero confidence elsewhere.
fixed_method.primitive_unary: Replay exact W.T on c*p and c*(1-p); primitive source confidence is W.T(c)/W.T(1).
fixed_method.boundary: source_confidence > 0, with no numeric confidence threshold
fixed_method.graph: Frozen canonical shared support graph; unnormalized symmetric nonnegative affinity Laplacian.
fixed_method.boundary_value: The already fused graph-off primitive unary probability, exactly preserved.
fixed_method.unobserved_component: If a graph component has no boundary, preserve its graph-off field/unary prior bit-for-bit.
fixed_method.hard_seed_threshold: Reuse the sealed base compiler value 0.20; no new method threshold.

next_step_if_pass: Seal a separate prediction authority before any new target scoring. Do not add target-derived routing, thresholds, or per-scene exceptions.
next_step_if_fail: Stop this graph-completion branch and retain the graph-off 0.7477712404 candidate.
